status: Victory Road's cave tiled with 81 blocks; behaviour in sealed rock is EXP-033
note: Every Habitat Block the campaign places. A re-export erases blocks placed in game (EXP-021), so this manifest is the source: tools/habitat_blocks.py function writes the placement function, and the post-export procedure in docs/world-building/REEXPORT.md re-applies it and restarts the server so each block's chunk reloads. tools/validate_data.py checks the static rules, and checks presence in a stopped world passed with --world-save. Blocks placed on the disposable proof world for EXP-021 are not campaign blocks and are not listed.

fields.place: what the block gives its identity to
fields.replace_spawns: true replaces the ambient pool inside the range (EXP-021)
fields.range_of_influence: blocks; the measured edge is this value, horizontally. Ranges of ReplaceSpawns blocks must not overlap
fields.status: planned (not in the world), placed (placed by the function), verified (presence and behaviour checked in game)
